verdict.rationale: The release notes mention an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, which directly matches AI-generated insights from the user's data, but this rests on a single one-line mention. Related features such as LLM-as-a-judge scoring and metrics auto-tuned from natural-language feedback are evaluation mechanics, not insights or suggestions, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of what the AI Assistant analyzes and what suggestions it produces, how it surfaces insights in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
